note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.2 ("An implementation MUST reject Hold Time values of one or two seconds."). TestOpenValidateHoldTime drives message.Open.ValidateHoldTime (called by session_handlers.go on received OPENs): negative cases reject HoldTime 1 and 2 with exact *Notification{ErrorCode: NotifyOpenMessage (2), ErrorSubcode: NotifyOpenUnacceptableHoldTime (6)}; positive cases accept 0, 3, 90, 180, and 65535.
